bugs.error_message: NOTAIO_BUNDLE_LIFETIME_SECONDS=15m silently used 3600; 0 or negative accepted
bugs.root_cause: env value parsed with .ok().and_then(parse().ok()).unwrap_or(default): no error path, no bounds
bugs.fix: cli::bundle_lifetime_seconds: 300..=86400, startup error naming the variable (ADR-0018)

bugs.error_message: per-policy metrics and NotaioBundleNearExpiry named namespace notaio-system
bugs.root_cause: PodMonitor without honorLabels: Prometheus overwrote notaio's namespace label with the target's and moved it to exported_namespace

bugs.error_message: NotaioBundleNearExpiry fired: bundle re-signed with 205 s of its lifetime left instead of half
bugs.root_cause: an unchanged reconcile requeued a fixed half-lifetime, regardless of when the bundle turns stale; a reconcile just before that point pushed the refresh to almost notAfter
bugs.fix: refresh::next_check: requeue at the earlier of the evaluator's requeue and the stale moment (+1 s)

bugs.error_message: In --require-hashes mode, all requirements must have their versions pinned with ==: importlib-metadata>=4.11.4 (from keyring)
bugs.root_cause: Dependabot regenerated the uv lock without --python-version 3.11, dropping importlib-metadata and zipp (keyring needs them below 3.12); docs CI only runs on docs changes, so main did not show it
bugs.fix: uv pip compile with the header's command, constraining importlib-metadata==9.0.0 and zipp==4.1.0; verify with pip install --require-hashes in python:3.11-slim

bugs.error_message: In --require-hashes mode, all requirements must have their versions pinned with ==: typing_extensions>=4.16.0 (from anyio)
bugs.root_cause: Recurrence of bug-004: Dependabot's poetry 2.3.4 bump (#113) recompiled the lock without --python-version 3.11, dropping eight packages 3.11 needs (typing-extensions, importlib-metadata, zipp, cachecontrol, backports-tarfile, backports-zstd, lazy-importer, pbs-installer). The docs job failed on #113, #114 and #115, but approving a held lock PR turns auto-merge on and the main ruleset does not require the docs check, so all three merged red
bugs.fix: Recompile with the header's uv command in python:3.11-slim and verify pip install --require-hashes there. The gap that let it merge is the approval path in dependabot-auto-merge.yaml, not the lock
